If the UAC supports extensions to SIP that can be applied by the
   server to the response, the UAC SHOULD include a Supported header
   field in the request listing the option tags (Section 19.2) for those
   extensions.
legal: 当 UAC 支持可被服务器应用于响应的 SIP 扩展时，请求中应包含 Supported 头字段，并列出这些扩展的 option tag
illegal: UAC 支持可被服务器应用于响应的 SIP 扩展，但请求中未包含 Supported 头字段，或未列出相应 option tag

text:
Implementations that send requests
   containing multipart message bodies MUST send a session description
   as a non-multipart message body if the remote implementation requests
   this through an Accept header field that does not contain multipart.
legal: 当远端实现通过 Accept 头字段请求非 multipart 消息体（即 Accept 不包含 multipart）时，发送方必须发送非 multipart 消息体形式的会话描述
illegal: 在 Accept 头字段不包含 multipart 的情况下，仍发送包含 multipart 消息体的请求
trigger: 接收方应拒绝该请求（具体响应码未在句中规定）
expected_behavior: 接收方应拒绝该请求（具体响应码未在句中规定）

text:
Implementations processing SIP messages over stream-oriented
   transports MUST ignore any CRLF appearing before the start-line
   [H4.1].
legal: 在流式传输上处理 SIP 消息时，起始行之前出现的 CRLF 必须被忽略
illegal: 起始行之前出现 CRLF
trigger: 忽略起始行之前出现的 CRLF
expected_behavior: 忽略起始行之前出现的 CRLF

text:
Route Set: A route set is a collection of ordered SIP or SIPS URI
         which represent a list of proxies that must be traversed when
         sending a particular request.
legal: 路由集必须是有序的 SIP 或 SIPS URI 集合，表示发送特定请求时必须经过的代理列表
illegal: 路由集中包含非 SIP/SIPS 的 URI，或路由集无序

text:
Independent
   of which URI is used as input to the procedures of [4], if the
   Request-URI specifies a SIPS resource, the UAC MUST follow the
   procedures of [4] as if the input URI were a SIPS URI.
legal: 若 Request-URI 指定 SIPS 资源，则 UAC 必须按输入 URI 为 SIPS URI 的方式执行 [4] 的流程
illegal: Request-URI 指定 SIPS 资源，但 UAC 未按 SIPS URI 输入执行 [4] 的流程
trigger: UAC 必须将输入 URI 视为 SIPS URI 并遵循 [4] 的流程
expected_behavior: UAC 必须将输入 URI 视为 SIPS URI 并遵循 [4] 的流程

text:
Regardless of
   the type of body that a request contains, certain header fields must
   be formulated to characterize the contents of the body.
legal: 必须构造用于描述消息体内容的头字段
illegal: 请求包含消息体但缺少描述其内容的头字段

text:
The UAC SHOULD follow the procedures defined in [4] for stateful
   elements, trying each address until a server is contacted.
legal: UAC 应依次尝试每个地址，直到联系到服务器
illegal: 未按顺序尝试地址或未尝试全部地址即放弃
trigger: 按 [4] 中有状态元素流程逐个尝试地址，直到成功联系到服务器
expected_behavior: 按 [4] 中有状态元素流程逐个尝试地址，直到成功联系到服务器

text:
Note that
   the empty line MUST be present even if the message-body is not.
legal: 空行必须存在，即使消息体为空
illegal: 消息体为空时省略空行

text:
The Internet media type of the message body MUST be given by the
   Content-Type header field.
legal: 消息体的 Internet 媒体类型必须由 Content-Type 头字段给出
illegal: 缺少 Content-Type 头字段，或未通过该字段给出消息体的 Internet 媒体类型

text:
If the Request-URI contains a SIPS URI, any alternate destinations
   MUST be contacted with TLS.
legal: 当 Request-URI 为 SIPS URI 时，所有备用目的地必须使用 TLS 联系
illegal: Request-URI 含 SIPS URI 时，以非 TLS 传输（如 UDP/TCP）联系备用目的地
trigger: 拒绝以非 TLS 方式联系备用目的地，仅使用 TLS 进行联系
expected_behavior: 拒绝以非 TLS 方式联系备用目的地，仅使用 TLS 进行联系

text:
Unlike a proxy server, it maintains dialog
         state and must participate in all requests sent on the dialogs
         it has established.
legal: 必须维护 dialog 状态，并参与其已建立 dialog 上的所有请求
illegal: 未维护 dialog 状态，或未参与已建立 dialog 上的请求
trigger: 必须维护 dialog 状态并参与该 dialog 上的所有请求
expected_behavior: 必须维护 dialog 状态并参与该 dialog 上的所有请求

text:
If a fatal transport error is reported by the transport layer
   (generally, due to fatal ICMP errors in UDP or connection failures in
   TCP), the condition MUST be treated as a 503 (Service Unavailable)
   status code.
legal: 传输层报告致命传输错误（如 UDP 的致命 ICMP 错误或 TCP 连接失败）时，该条件必须被视为 503 (Service Unavailable) 状态码
illegal: 传输层报告致命传输错误（UDP 致命 ICMP 错误或 TCP 连接失败）
trigger: 将条件视为 503 (Service Unavailable) 状态码
expected_behavior: 将条件视为 503 (Service Unavailable) 状态码

text:
In order to determine how the request
         should be answered, it acts as a user agent client (UAC) and
         generates requests.

If the body has undergone any encoding
   such as compression, then this MUST be indicated by the Content-
   Encoding header field; otherwise, Content-Encoding MUST be omitted.
legal: 若消息体经过压缩等编码，则必须由 Content-Encoding 头字段指示；否则必须省略 Content-Encoding
illegal: 消息体经过压缩等编码但未携带 Content-Encoding 头字段，或消息体未经编码却携带了 Content-Encoding 头字段

text:
The Content-Length header field value is used to locate the end of
      each SIP message in a stream.
legal: 该字段值用于定位流中每条 SIP 消息的结束位置
illegal: Content-Length 缺失或取值与实际消息体长度不一致，导致无法正确定位消息边界

text:
This typical arrangement is often referred to as the
   "SIP trapezoid" as shown by the geometric shape of the dotted lines
   in Figure 1.

Likewise, the client MUST discard any
   knowledge obtained from the server, such as the list of SMTP service
   extensions, which was not obtained from the SASL negotiation itself.
legal: 客户端必须丢弃任何从服务器获得的知识（例如 SMTP 服务扩展列表），除非该知识来自 SASL 协商本身
illegal: 客户端保留从服务器获得但并非来自 SASL 协商本身的知识（如 SMTP 服务扩展列表）
trigger: 客户端丢弃该知识，不将其用于后续处理
expected_behavior: 客户端丢弃该知识，不将其用于后续处理

text:
In all cases, the "From:" field SHOULD NOT contain any mailbox that
   does not belong to the author(s) of the message.
legal: SHOULD NOT contain any mailbox that does not belong to the author(s) of the message
illegal: From field contains a mailbox not belonging to the message author(s)

text:
The client SHOULD send an EHLO command as the first command after a
   successful SASL negotiation that results in the enabling of a
   security layer.
legal: SASL 协商成功并启用安全层后，客户端应将 EHLO 命令作为第一条命令发送
illegal: SASL 协商成功并启用安全层后，客户端未发送 EHLO 命令，或发送的第一条命令不是 EHLO

text:
In some hosts, the distinction between a mailing list and an alias
   for a single mailbox is a bit fuzzy, since a common data structure
   may hold both types of entries, and it is possible to have mailing
   lists containing only one mailbox.

Each token must be a word, angle-addr, addr-
   spec, or a domain.
legal: 每个 token 必须是 word、angle-addr、addr-spec 或 domain 之一
illegal: token 不属于 word、angle-addr、addr-spec、domain 中的任何一种

text:
When resent fields are used, the "Resent-From:" and "Resent-Date:"
   fields MUST be sent.
legal: 使用重发字段时，必须发送 Resent-From 字段
illegal: 使用了重发字段但缺少 Resent-From 字段

text:
Servers MUST NOT return the extended EHLO-
   style response to a HELO command.
legal: 服务器对 HELO 命令不得返回扩展的 EHLO 风格响应
illegal: 服务器对 HELO 命令返回扩展的 EHLO 风格响应
trigger: 服务器不得返回扩展的 EHLO 风格响应
expected_behavior: 服务器不得返回扩展的 EHLO 风格响应

text: They MUST conform to the syntax of an optional-field.
legal: 必须符合 optional-field 的语法
illegal: 不符合 optional-field 语法的输入

text:
When an entity (whether it is the client or the server end) is
   sending data, and both [TLS] and SASL security layers are in effect,
   the TLS encoding MUST be applied after the SASL encoding, regardless
   of the order in which the layers were negotiated.
legal: 当 TLS 和 SASL 安全层同时生效时，TLS 编码必须在 SASL 编码之后应用，与协商顺序无关
illegal: 在 SASL 编码之前应用 TLS 编码（即先 TLS 后 SASL）

text:
After a
          successful AUTH command completes, a server MUST reject any
          further AUTH commands with a 503 reply.
legal: 成功完成 AUTH 命令后，服务器必须拒绝任何进一步的 AUTH 命令
illegal: 在成功完成 AUTH 命令后再次发送 AUTH 命令
trigger: 拒绝该 AUTH 命令并返回 503 回复
expected_behavior: 拒绝该 AUTH 命令并返回 503 回复

text:
If the
   client and server are using the ENHANCEDSTATUSCODES ESMTP extension
   [RFC2034], the status code to be returned SHOULD be 5.7.0.
legal: 当客户端和服务器使用 ENHANCEDSTATUSCODES ESMTP 扩展时，返回的状态码应为 5.7.0
illegal: 返回的状态码不是 5.7.0
trigger: 返回增强状态码 5.7.0
expected_behavior: 返回增强状态码 5.7.0

text: 12288 octets is considered to be a sufficient line length
legal: 行长度不得超过 12288 octets
illegal: 行长度超过 12288 octets

text:
It MUST be in either of the following
   forms:

(*) Note: Future revision of this specification may change this
      requirement to MUST.

If a
   RCPT command appears without a previous MAIL command, the server MUST
   return a 503 "Bad sequence of commands" response.
legal: RCPT 命令必须出现在 MAIL 命令之后（即存在前置 MAIL 命令）
illegal: 在没有前置 MAIL 命令的情况下发送 RCPT 命令
trigger: 返回 503 "Bad sequence of commands" 响应
expected_behavior: 返回 503 "Bad sequence of commands" 响应

text:
If there
   are options in this section where one option SHOULD be generated,
   that is indicated either in the prose or in a comment next to the
   syntax.
legal: 若本节中某选项被标注为 SHOULD be generated，则发送方应生成该选项
illegal: 未生成被标注为 SHOULD be generated 的选项
trigger: 接收方应能容忍该选项缺失，不应因此报错
expected_behavior: 接收方应能容忍该选项缺失，不应因此报错

text:
In the absence of the "Reply-To:" field,
   replies SHOULD by default be sent to the mailbox(es) specified in the
   "From:" field unless otherwise specified by the person composing the
   reply.
legal: 当 Reply-To 字段缺失时，回复默认应发送到 From 字段指定的邮箱（除非回复者另有指定）
illegal: Reply-To 字段缺失且 From 字段也缺失，导致无法确定默认回复地址
trigger: 接收方应将回复默认发送到 From 字段指定的邮箱
expected_behavior: 接收方应将回复默认发送到 From 字段指定的邮箱

text:
"Resent-Sender:" SHOULD NOT be used if "Resent-Sender:" would be
   identical to "Resent-From:".
legal: 当 Resent-Sender 的值与 Resent-From 的值相同时，不应使用 Resent-Sender 字段
illegal: Resent-Sender 的值与 Resent-From 的值完全相同

text:
If the
   string can be represented as a dot-atom (that is, it contains no
   characters other than atext characters or "." surrounded by atext
   characters), then the dot-atom form SHOULD be used and the quoted-
   string form SHOULD NOT be used.
legal: 当字符串可表示为 dot-atom（仅含 atext 字符，或由 atext 字符包围的“.”）时，应使用 dot-atom 形式，不应使用 quoted-string 形式
illegal: 对可表示为 dot-atom 的字符串使用 quoted-string 形式

text:
Unless the different characteristics of HELO must be identified for
   interoperability purposes, this document discusses only EHLO.
legal: 除非出于互操作性目的必须识别 HELO 的不同特性，否则应仅讨论 EHLO
illegal: 在非互操作性场景下使用 HELO 而非 EHLO

text:
that folding can take place between many of the lexical tokens
      (and even within some of the lexical tokens), folding SHOULD be
      limited to placing the CRLF at higher-level syntactic breaks.
legal: 折行应限制在高层语法断点处放置 CRLF
illegal: 在低层语法断点或词法记号内部放置 CRLF 进行折行

text:
An unfolded header field has no length restriction and
   therefore may be indeterminately long.
legal: 无长度限制，可以是不定长
illegal: 对展开后的头部字段施加长度上限或拒绝超长字段
trigger: 接收方应接受任意长度的展开头部字段，不得因长度而拒绝
expected_behavior: 接收方应接受任意长度的展开头部字段，不得因长度而拒绝

text:
o  the increment by which the extension is increasing the maximum
      length of the commands MAIL and/or RCPT, over that specified in
      this Standard.
legal: 扩展所增加的 MAIL 和/或 RCPT 命令最大长度增量不得超过本标准规定的值
illegal: 扩展声明的长度增量超过本标准规定的 MAIL/RCPT 命令最大长度

text:
This response SHOULD be returned by any command other than AUTH,
   EHLO, HELO, NOOP, RSET, or QUIT when server policy requires
   authentication in order to perform the requested action and
   authentication is not currently in force.
legal: 当服务器策略要求认证而当前未认证时，除 AUTH、EHLO、HELO、NOOP、RSET、QUIT 之外的任何命令都应返回该响应
illegal: 在未认证且服务器要求认证的情况下，对除 AUTH、EHLO、HELO、NOOP、RSET、QUIT 之外的命令返回其他响应或不返回该响应
trigger: 返回该响应（认证要求响应）
expected_behavior: 返回该响应（认证要求响应）

text:
Both the client and the server MUST know if there is a TLS session
   active.
legal: 客户端和服务器都必须知道是否存在活动的 TLS 会话
illegal: 一方或双方无法确定 TLS 会话是否处于活动状态

text:
Also indicated what response codes
       should result in a client prompting the user for new credentials.
legal: 响应码应指示客户端何时提示用户输入新凭据
illegal: 响应码未触发客户端提示用户输入新凭据
trigger: 客户端提示用户输入新凭据
expected_behavior: 客户端提示用户输入新凭据

text:
SMTP client implementations MUST NOT transmit
   these characters except when they are intended as line terminators
   and then MUST, as indicated above, transmit them only as a <CRLF>
   sequence.
field: SMTP 消息内容中的 CR/LF 字符
legal: SMTP 客户端不得传输 CR 和 LF 字符，除非它们作为行终止符，且此时只能以 <CRLF> 序列传输
illegal: 在消息内容中单独传输 CR 或 LF 字符，或将其用作非行终止符的用途
trigger: 接收方应拒绝或视为协议违规
expected_behavior: 接收方应拒绝或视为协议违规

text:
[ISO.2022.1994], [RFC2045],
   [RFC2046], [RFC2047], [RFC2049], [RFC4288], [RFC4289]) and therefore
   should not be stripped indiscriminately.

o  The domain name given in the EHLO command MUST be either a primary
      host name (a domain name that resolves to an address RR) or, if
      the host has no name, an address literal, as described in
      Section 4.1.3 and discussed further in the EHLO discussion of
      Section 4.1.4.
legal: EHLO 命令中给出的域名必须是主主机名（可解析为地址 RR 的域名），或者当主机没有名称时，必须是地址字面量
illegal: EHLO 命令中给出的域名既不是可解析为地址 RR 的主主机名，也不是地址字面量

text:
For this reason, clients and servers MUST discard any knowledge
   obtained prior to the start of the TLS handshake upon completion of
   the TLS handshake.
legal: 客户端和服务器必须在 TLS 握手完成后丢弃握手开始前获得的任何知识
illegal: 在 TLS 握手完成后仍保留或使用握手开始前获得的知识
trigger: 丢弃握手开始前获得的所有知识
expected_behavior: 丢弃握手开始前获得的所有知识

text:
When the terms "MUST", "SHOULD", "RECOMMENDED", "MUST NOT", "SHOULD
   NOT", and "MAY" appear capitalized, they are being used to indicate
   particular requirements of this specification.

8BITMIME SHOULD be supported by SMTP
   servers.
legal: SMTP 服务器应支持 8BITMIME 扩展
illegal: SMTP 服务器不支持 8BITMIME 扩展

text:
The additional option of using TLS when
   possible SHOULD also be provided.
legal: SHOULD also be provided as an additional option when possible
illegal: TLS option not provided when possible

text:
illustrative examples that should not actually be used in either code
   or configuration files.

A
   message that is conformant with this specification is composed of
   characters with values in the range of 1 through 127 and interpreted
   as US-ASCII [ANSI.X3-4.1986] characters.
legal: 消息由取值在 1 到 127 范围内、并按 US-ASCII 解释的字符组成
illegal: 消息中包含取值小于 1 或大于 127 的字符

text:
The editors would like to acknowledge the contributions of John Myers
   and other contributors to RFC 2554, on which this document draws from
   heavily.

Any examples in this section MUST NOT be taken as
   specification of the formal syntax of any part of a message.
legal: 本节中的示例不得被视为消息任何部分的形式语法规范
illegal: 将本节示例当作消息某部分的形式语法规范

text:
In
   order to defend against such attacks both clients and servers MUST be
   able to be configured to require successful TLS negotiation of an
   appropriate cipher suite for selected hosts before messages can be
   successfully transferred.
legal: 对于选定的主机，在消息成功传输前必须完成适当的密码套件 TLS 协商
illegal: 在未完成适当密码套件的 TLS 协商的情况下尝试传输消息
trigger: 拒绝消息传输
expected_behavior: 拒绝消息传输

text:
However, this
   document itself may not be modified in any way, such as by removing
   the copyright notice or references to the Internet Society or other
   Internet organizations, except as needed for the purpose of
   developing Internet standards in which case the procedures for
   copyrights defined in the Internet Standards process must be
legal: 文档不得以任何方式修改，例如不得移除版权声明或对 Internet Society 或其他 Internet 组织的引用
illegal: 移除版权声明或对 Internet Society 或其他 Internet 组织的引用

text:
The syntax included in
   section 3 represents messages as they MUST be created.
legal: messages MUST be created according to the syntax in section 3
illegal: message created with syntax not conforming to section 3
